reason: I don't buy anything for my face until I've read the reviews and seen photos from women my age, and this has none. Thirty-six dollars for a tinted balm is a lot on my budget for a brand I only know from a Facebook ad.
objection: No reviews at all, and it will probably dry my lips or look like nothing on me, like the rest of that drawer. A year-long guarantee sounds nice, but I'd still have to trust a company I've never heard of to actually pay me back.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews on Trustpilot or Amazon with photos from women over 50 saying it kept their lips soft and didn't bleed into the lines.
